selection.rule: First neural seed in ascending integer order whose single swat escapes with a recorded neural takeoff onset strictly before impact. Walk 1500 ms, observe the current body position at tick 3000, aim there, fixed 600 ms hold. Environment seed 8128. Every tried seed is retained; no aesthetic selection.
selection.aim: Current body position at 1500 ms; no lead
selection.og_rule: Recorded hero replay frame with maximum observed spike count
selection.lab_media: Re-record new story at registered strength, step 1 then step 2.

game.source: Authoritative current-position swat after 1500 ms at real speed. Strike intervals shown 5x slower. Stamp lasts 1.6 presentation seconds. Replay uses ordinary quarter speed; every neural frame is recorded.

og.source: Recorded hero replay frame with maximum observed spike count

intro.brain: Same recorded maximum-spike hero frame as OG
intro.timeline: Canvas snapshot of its three recorded tracks

sign.rule: First V2E T1a N-SIGN null in ascending seed order whose s* equals the family median; no other outcome enters selection.

strength.scope: Data-only export of an existing null. UI is unchanged; no new scientific trial.
strength.selection_rule: the T1a H0-STR N-STRENGTH null whose H0b equals the family median of the 499 values; ties go to the lowest index.

engineering_fixture_probes.reason: Retain all seed 1-6 diagnostic workload probes used to choose an actual caught presentation fixture and inspect pre-strike spontaneous flights. Rule was already frozen; these do not change ascending hero selection. Recomputed with identical game parameters for a complete machine-readable trace.

review.source: Two sequences of 100 captured UI frames, caught then escaped, encoded at 20 frames per second for 10 seconds. No neural re-execution or invented observations.

palette_revision.rule: 112-color global median-cut palette from every tenth full-size frame; reserve sample area for semantic green #63F29A and five sampled tan body shades; no dithering; unchanged frame order, size and 50 ms timing.
